svg.title: SQLite database and Google Sheets schema in even grid columns, jointly optimized to minimize crossing lines
svg.desc: Three separate zones, each a clean aligned grid. Table positions were chosen by a joint hill-climbing search across all three zones at once (swaps kept within each zone) directly minimizing the number of line crossings plus total line length.
svg.text: SQLite database — single source of truth
Gray = SQLite table · Blue = Control Sheet (one, shared) · Green = Per-hub Sheet (one per hub) · Bold field = primary/unique key
